structure.unit: Local Government Personnel, Qualification for Office, Bonds, Dual Office Holding and Certain Local Government Officers

law.catch_line: Bond plan to be forwarded to clerk and Comptroller
law.text: The state Department of the Treasury, Division of Risk Management shall forward to the clerk of the circuit court for each county and city and the Comptroller of the Commonwealth a copy of the plan promulgated pursuant to subsection B of § 2.2-1840.
